text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Just... one... more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are wrapping up our
days of
intensive training for the
Kawasaki Kinen.
choice_data_list: ああ、それで総仕上げだ……！
うん、それで総仕上げだよ……！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, and that'll be the final touch...!
Yeah, that'll be the finishing touch...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has to push past her limits. It should
be
possible... at least, according to the
training plan
I wrote up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But this plan is so ruthless, I doubt any
trainer in
their right mind would ask this
of their trainee.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Wonder Acute has tossed common
wisdom
aside to tackle this reckless
plan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I've been forced to harden my
heart to
join her in that pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: HAAAYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... That's... all I've got...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute collapses into the dirt,
and I ease
myself onto the ground next
to her.
choice_data_list: よくやったな、アキュート
よくやったね、アキュート

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I told myself I hardened my heart, yet... I
can't
help these tears streaming down
my cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm sorry. You're hurting
because of
me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Don't cry, please... You can't...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This training has been hell for the both
of us.
But... I think it's paid off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, on the day of the race...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Kawasaki! ☆ Nice to meet all of
you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry it's taken me so long to come visit,
but I'll
make sure the wait was worth it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Me and my fellow dirt racers are gonna
show you
one heck of a race today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is at the center of
attention again.
She's the reason dirt
races have become as
popular as they
are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how impressive a figure
she may
be, we have no intention of
lying back and
handing her the win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First things first—our big entrance. Taiko
drums
ring out across the stadium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom! Bangbangbangbangbangbangbang!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with this pomp and
circumstance?
choice_data_list: ワンダーアキュート、ご出座ー！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is this some kind of performance?
Haha! ☆ Now
we're talking!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for bringing the heat today,
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you enjoyed the show...
Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Acute? What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The point of the intro was just to have a
bit of
fun. All the same...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like something in Wonder
Acute's
manner has tipped Smart Falcon
off about her
newly matured strength.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank you for encouraging me
to run
here today. With that said...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of letting you take
the lead
today. I'm going to be... what
was it again?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The center sage, was it? I've come here
today
planning to take the spotlight
from you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I need to improve my luster if I want to
inspire
others to pick themselves up
after they fall.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My poor, sweet trainer shed tears for
this as well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh... There's something different about
you...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have a lot more stage experience than
you,
but... you seem like a real pro
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's no wonder. All those long hours
of
training have given Wonder Acute the
aura of a
seasoned fighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By taking her far beyond her limits,
we've honed
Wonder Acute's cunning
senses to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying that this person
standing in front
of me now is... the real
you? If so...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
YEEESSS! Let's go! Let's go! Let's go, go,
gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...?!
F-Falco?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry! Guess I got a bit carried away!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm just super happy! I've had a lot of
people look
up to me over the years...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But you're the first one to tell me you're
gunning
for my spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Can I trust you, Acute? Are you
absolutely,
positively sure you're here to
take center stage?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm not messing around. I'll be in
the
spotlight today. No one else.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry, dear. I'll be happy to
comfort
you after the race if you need it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! ☆ As if! But if you really mean
it, that
means you're not just someone
looking up to me
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you're a rival for the top
spot in
dirt racing! So bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Smart Falcon has been
waiting for
this challenge for some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's Kawasaki Kinen marks the
beginning of a
new era—one made
possible because Wonder
Acute
challenged her limits.
